summary: Waterview post-cutover corrections. A: the duplicate $42.00 legal bill-back (JE-2026-00232, 8/31/2026; the same attorney invoice Vantaca charged the homeowner on 6/26, already in the 7/31 opening AR) is reversed on 8/31 (Dr 5870 / Cr 1300, linked by reverses_je_id; the original is voided and names its reversal), and a -$42.00 homeowner credit is posted against the duplicate trustEd charge in the same transaction. GL 1300 and the homeowner ledger both fall by $42.00; both originals stay. B: Amazon order 112-0467422-8439405 (unposted) gets its lines corrected to the receipt (napkins 3 x $4.99 = $14.97, the duplicate $2.59 tax line removed), so lines 31.45 + header tax 2.59 = total 34.04; no journal entry is written for it here.
